Grows at 3% or 7% per month (possible switch in months 8..15).\nfor label, r1, r2, sw in [\n    (\"3% const\", 0.03, 0.03, 24),\n    (\"3%->7% m8\", 0.03, 0.07, 8),\n    (\"7%->3% m12\", 0.07, 0.03, 12),\n    (\"7% const\", 0.07, 0.07, 24),\n]:\n    inf = []\n    val = 6.0\n    for m in range(24):\n        inf.append(val)\n        r = r1 if m < sw else r2\n        val *= (1 + r)\n    w0 = sum(inf[0:8])\n    w1 = sum(inf[8:16])\n    w2 = sum(inf[16:24])\n    print(f\"{label:12s} | W0(0..7) inf={w0:5.1f} +60={w0+60:5.1f} ({(w0+60)/8:4.1f}/m)\"\n          f\" | W1(8..15) inf={w1:5.1f} +140={w1+140:5.1f} ({(w1+140)/8:4.1f}/m)\"\n          f\" | W2(16..23) inf={w2:5.1f} +320={w2+320:5.1f} ({(w2+320)/8:4.1f}/m)\"\n          f\" | m23_inf={inf[23]:4.1f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/plan.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/plan.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/plan.py","time":{"start":1794663474437,"end":1794663474461}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da4764ea001fzgWyx3GWNLR60","sessionID":"ses_e25b9d986ffeBbQ4VjsjIHY14E","messageID":"msg_1da46ac2d0014t0mfUqEnpYk9e"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794663514514,"sessionID":"ses_e25b9d986ffeBbQ4VjsjIHY14E","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"yGVf0iegs3h8xr4m","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"# Economic comparison of capacity sources across the 24 months\n\n# 1. Gen H bought at month m0, delivered & powered from m_start to 23 (held to end):\n# End value credit at month 24 (post Gen N launch): 0.75 * (25 * 0.60 * 0.98^24)\nh_end_credit = 0.75 * 25.0 * 0.60 * (0.98 ** 24)\nprint(f\"Gen H month-24 mark-to-market credit: ${h_end_credit:.3f}M per 1k (1 kH)\")\n\nfor m0 in [0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8]:\n    m_use = m0 + 3\n    months_used = 24 - m_use\n    # Suppose financed partially on credit line for some months? First ignore interest, then include 2%/mo for say 6 months\n    net_capex = 25.0 - h_end_credit\n    pwr_per_mo = 1.4 * 0.15 * (24 / max(months_used, 1)) # conservative if dedicated 24m power\n    print(f\"  Vendor H ordered m={m0} (used m={m_use}..23, {months_used}m): capex/m=${net_capex/months_used:.3f}M, +pwr=${net_capex/months_used + 0.25:.3f}M/kH-m\")\n\n# Broker A Gen H (cost 27.5M if delivered; if 10% cancel -> lose 20% of 27.5M = $5.5M!)\n# Wait! Let's check Broker expected cost!\nfor name, mult, p_rel, p_unrel in [(\"Broker A\", 1.10, 0.90, 0.35), (\"Broker B\", 1.25, 0.90, 0.35)]:\n    price_H = 25.0 * mult\n    cancel_loss_H = 0.20 * price_H\n    # Expected extra cost per DELIVERED 1k H:\n    # If reliable (p=0.9): pay price_H when delivered, plus (0.1/0.9)*cancel_loss_H expected cancel fee!\n    eff_H_rel = price_H + (1 - p_rel)/p_rel * cancel_loss_H\n    eff_H_prior = price_H + (1 - 0.625)/0.625 * cancel_loss_H\n    eff_H_unrel = price_H + (1 - p_unrel)/p_unrel * cancel_loss_H\n    print(f\"{name} H: price=${price_H:.2f}M, cancel_loss=${cancel_loss_H:.2f}M | eff_cost/deliv: rel=${eff_H_rel:.2f}M, 50/50=${eff_H_prior:.2f}M, unrel=${eff_H_unrel:.2f}M\")\n\n# 2. Gen N launched at month L (11..18), costs $40M for 2 kH ($20M/kH), needs 1.6 MW (0.8 MW/kH)\nprint(\"\\nGen N economics (per 1 kH = 0.5k GPUs, cost $20M vendor):\")\nfor L in [11, 13, 15, 17]:\n    n_end_credit_per_1kGPU = 0.75 * 40.0 * (0.98 ** (24 - L))\n    credit_per_kH = n_end_credit_per_1kGPU / 2.0\n    net_capex_kH = 20.0 - credit_per_kH\n    for delay, src, extra in [(3, \"Vendor\", 0.0), (2, \"RelBrokerA\", (4.0*1.1 - 4.0) + (0.1/0.9)*0.2*22.0 - 2.0)]:\n        pass\n    m_use = L + 3\n    months_used = max(0, 24 - m_use)\n    print(f\"  Launch L={L}: m24 credit=${credit_per_kH:.2f}M/kH, net_capex=${net_capex_kH:.2f}M/kH | if used m={m_use}..23 ({months_used}m): ${net_capex_kH/max(1,months_used):.3f}M/kH-m (+pwr ~$0.15-0.30M)\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/econ.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/econ.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/econ.py","time":{"start":1794663514497,"end":1794663514507}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da4801700013XjOfEYY2yf0va","sessionID":"ses_e25b9d986ffeBbQ4VjsjIHY14E","messageID":"msg_1da4766e200105Elh2pjJx3DRg"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794663588495,"sessionID":"ses_e25b9d986ffeBbQ4VjsjIHY14E","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"msPzrN1oTgReovCe","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"# Let's check Cash Flow, Power Requirements, and Optimal Capacity Mix across W0, W1, W2!\n\n# Funding:\n# Start: $400M cash, +$40M at end of each month (24 * 40 = $960M total funding -> $1,360M total cash inflows before expenses!)\n# Credit line: down to -$500M (at 2%/mo interest on negative balance).\n# Notice: if we stay >= $0 cash, we pay ZERO interest!\n# Even if we dip negative briefly for high-ROI GPUs, 2%/mo on $100M is $2M/mo, whereas staying cash-positive saves 2%/mo ($0.5M/mo per $25M GPU!).\n\n# Let's check how much Owned GPU capacity vs Cloud/Spot we want in each window:\n# Window 0 (m 0..7): need ~114 - 122 kH-m total (14.2 - 15.2 kH/m), plus safety buffer -> target ~120-126 depending on observed inf growth!\n# Already have in W0:\n# - Powered H with 16 MW alone: m0: 10.0 kH; m1..7: 11.43 kH/m * 7 = 80.0 kH-m -> TOTAL = 90.0 kH-m from EXISTING 16 MW + 14k H GPUs!!\n# - Existing Cloud Contract: 2 kH in m0..4 = 10.0 kH-m!!\n# WAIT A SECOND!\n# 90.0 + 10.0 = 100.0 kH-m ALREADY LOCKED IN for Window 0 (months 0..7)!!\nprint(\"Locked-in W0 capacity (with just 16MW + existing 10k+4k H + existing 2kH cloud m0..4):\")\nprint(\"  m0: 10.0 (H) + 2.0 (cloud) = 12.0 kH\")\nprint(\"  m1..4: 11.43 (H) + 2.0 (cloud) = 13.43 kH/m * 4 = 53.71 kH\")\nprint(\"  m5..7: 11.43 (H) * 3 = 34.29 kH\")\nprint(\"  Total locked-in W0 = 100.0 kH-m! Need only ~14 to 22 kH-m MORE across all 8 months of W0!!\")\n\n# Now check Window 1 (m 8..15): need 140 training + 68..106 inference = 208..246 kH-m (26.0..30.8 kH/m)!\n# Now check Window 2 (m 16..23): need 320 training + 86..182 inference = 406..502 kH-m (50.8..62.8 kH/m)!\n\n# Look at Power needed if we own:\n# Scenario: Suppose in W1 (m 8..15) we own ~24-28k Gen H GPUs:\n#   26k Gen H needs 26 * 1.4 = 36.4 MW total! (We already have 16 MW until m19, so +20.4 MW needed for 26k H, or +24 MW -> 40 MW total powers 28.57k H!)\n# And then in W2 (m 16..23), Gen N launches in m 11..18!\n#   Remember: Gen N is powered FIRST!\n#   Suppose by m 16..23 we have ~25k Gen H (left after any pre-launch resale) + ~12-18k Gen N (= 24-36 kH of Gen N!):\n#   - 15k Gen N (= 30 kH) needs 15 * 1.6 = 24.0 MW!\n#   - 22k Gen H (= 22 kH) needs 22 * 1.4 = 30.8 MW!\n#   - Total = 52 kH of owned GPUs needing ~54.8 MW in m16..19 and in m20..23 (when initial 16 MW expires!!)!\nprint(\"\\nPower check:\")\nfor n_gpu in [10, 14, 18]:\n    for h_gpu in [18, 22, 26]:\n        kh = 2*n_gpu + h_gpu\n        mw = 1.6*n_gpu + 1.4*h_gpu\n        print(f\"  {n_gpu}k N ({2*n_gpu} kH) + {h_gpu}k H ({h_gpu} kH) = {kh} kH | needs {mw:.1f} MW\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/power_cap.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/power_cap.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/power_cap.py","time":{"start":1794663588459,"end":1794663588464}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da49225e001p3b7J6X8ZNiarp","sessionID":"ses_e25b9d986ffeBbQ4VjsjIHY14E","messageID":"msg_1da4804e9001BgKdrxo4XH1M22"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794663955052,"sessionID":"ses_e25b9d986ffeBbQ4VjsjIHY14E","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"7lAsuQnhYlqVjTXl","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/w2_plan.py","content":"# Compare Window 2 (m 16..23) capacity building when Brokers A & B are BOTH unreliable (35%) and L in 13..17!\n# Current state at M6:\n# - Owned + queued H = 21.87 + 0.23 + 3.60 = 25.70k H (all delivered by M7, 100% powered by 36 MW!)\n# - W2 total demand (m 16..23, 8 months):\n#   * If inf stays 3%: ~406 kH-m (50.8 kH/m)\n#   * If inf switches 3%->7% in m8..15: ~430 to 454 kH-m (53.8 to 56.8 kH/m)\n# - Existing 25.7k H (if powered in m16..23) provides: 25.7 * 8 = 205.6 kH-m!\n# - Remaining W2 gap above 25.7k H = 200 to 250 kH-m (25.0 to 31.3 kH/m across m 16..23)!\n\n# How much can Vendor Gen N alone contribute in W2 (m 16..23) if we immediately queue Gen N at launch L?\nfor L in [13, 14, 15, 16, 17]:\n    for regime, alloc_n in [(\"loose (4k N = 8kH/m)\", 4.0), (\"tight (1.5k N = 3kH/m)\", 1.5)]:\n        # Order placed at L -> first shipment at end of L+2 (usable L+3), then each month after!\n        total_kHm = 0.0\n        active_n = 0.0\n        for m in range(16, 24):\n            # By month m, shipments happened at end of months L+2, L+3, ..., m-1\n            n_ships = max(0, m - (L + 2))\n            active_n = n_ships * alloc_n # in k GPUs\n            total_kHm += 2.0 * active_n\n        print(f\"L={L} {regime:24s}: Vendor N gives {total_kHm:5.1f} kH-m in W2 (peak {2*max(0, 23-(L+2))*alloc_n:4.1f} kH at m23)\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/w2_plan.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/w2_plan.py","time":{"start":1794663955010,"end":1794663955036}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da4eba27001DE457DZ7zhXVzz","sessionID":"ses_e25b9d986ffeBbQ4VjsjIHY14E","messageID":"msg_1da4dfafe0016P2IHy3peSoS6i"}}
